learning_objective: 🎯 Master the secret position words that tell us exactly where things are, when things happen, and where they are going!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A preposition is a smart little word that links a noun or pronoun to the rest of the sentence. It helps us understand the relationship between things, like 'The cat is UNDER the table'.
These words tell us WHERE something is located! Words like in, on, under, behind, and between are place prepositions. 'The apples are IN the basket.'
These words tell us exactly WHEN something happens! We use 'at' for clock time (at 5 PM), 'on' for days (on Monday), and 'in' for months or years (in June).

fun_activity.title: 🧸 The Hidden Toy Game
fun_activity.instructions: Hide your favorite small toy somewhere in your bedroom. Give your parents three clues using prepositions of place (like 'It is UNDER the bed' or 'It is BEHIND the door') so they can find it!

quick_recap: ⭐ Prepositions connect nouns to other words to show position, time, or direction.
⭐ Place prepositions (in, on, behind) tell us where something is.
⭐ Time prepositions (at, on, in) tell us when an action happens.
